title: Planetarium Commentary
premise: A commentary succession at the municipal planetarium. Axing and Achen look nearly alike and are easily mistaken; the celestial globe goes intact→gear-jammed→recalibrated; the commentary lift platform crashes and must be avoided; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). present items may be objects carrying confusable_with/count/anchor. op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.
_state_note: Entities with state machines use states; entities without use appearance. On transfer, only the current-state appearance is injected. Flashbacks may set state on a present item to a past state.

states.prime_on_duty: Chief planetarium commentator Gu Heng in his forties, neat short hair, deep-blue uniform jacket, a small Big Dipper badge at the collar, even speech, mild eyes.
states.weary_wounded: The same Gu Heng weary and wounded: uniform shoulder line worn through, gauze on the temple, Big Dipper badge still pinned, heavy steps.
states.stepped_away: Gu Heng has stepped away from the post; only his old deep-blue uniform and work badge remain in the planetarium—he himself no longer appears.

states.young_apprentice: Young Axing: a lean commentary apprentice of fourteen or fifteen, turmeric armband on the left sleeve, script under the arm, bright stubborn eyes.
states.adult_successor: Adult Axing: a tall upright successor commentator in the twenties, still the turmeric armband, steady eyes.

states.intact: A hemispheric celestial globe with intact brass meridian rings, complete star lamp beads, able to rotate evenly to demonstrate precession.
states.gear_jammed: The same celestial globe with gears jammed; star lamp beads half-lit; meridian ring skewed stuck.
states.recalibrated: After recalibration the celestial globe rotates smooth again, but a shallow repair weld remains on the base, distinct from the first intact state.

states.intact: A deep-blue leather star-script book filled with show cues and pointing coordinates, cover clean.
states.coffee_stained: The same star-script book coffee-stained; cover swollen, writing bled, a crumpled blotting sheet tucked in.

states.intact: A raisable commentary lift platform with intact rails and nonslip tread, able to rise to mid-dome for commentary.
states.crashed: The commentary lift platform cables snapped and crashed; rails twisted—only skewed wreckage left.

states.young_rival: Achen whose face and build closely resemble Axing's, but an amber star brooch, flamboyant and fond of grabbing the mic.
states.remade_face: After remaking the look, Achen still wears the amber star brooch, plus thin-frame glasses, expression deeper.

E10.appearance: Abandoned observatory plinth; cracked concrete ring; empty copper-column base; weeds push from seams.

E14.appearance: Venue shift leader Lao Liang, build somewhat like Gu Heng's, gray uniform with silver shoulder bars, cap badge a key not the Big Dipper.

lookalike_pairs.note: Hard misidentification sample: Axing and Achen look alike; tell them apart only by turmeric armband / amber star brooch.

scenes.setting: Dome planetarium daily (introduce five track spotlights · two opening cue bells)
actions: At dusk, Gu Heng pushes open the dome planetarium side door and pins the Big Dipper badge firm.

actions.action: Inside the dome planetarium hang a row of five track spotlights; Gu Heng polishes each one.
Two opening cue bells hang by the door; Gu Heng reaches to make them chime softly.

actions: Gu Heng circles the celestial globe checking every brass meridian ring and star lamp bead.
Gu Heng looks up as the dome's false starfield gradually brightens.

actions.action: The intact celestial globe rotates evenly at hall center; track spotlights sweep the star points.

actions: On the show sheet Gu Heng adds tonight's winter sky show and interactive Q&A slot.
Gu Heng takes the badge off and pins it back, confirming the clasp is tight.
Gu Heng sorts scattered laser-pointer batteries and restacks them by show.
Gu Heng sits in a front-row seat and rubs his sore neck and shoulders.

scenes.setting: Recording the star-script book
actions: Gu Heng opens the star-script book and writes tonight's constellation projections and cues by show.
Beside the Big Dipper pointing section he draws a blue star mark, reminding himself to dim half the dome lights.
Gu Heng closes the star-script book and clips it back into the lectern side pocket.

actions.action: Reflection from the celestial globe sweeps Gu Heng's profile.

actions: Checking the celestial globe, Gu Heng circles with red pen a meridian mark that turns a little slow.
Gu Heng returns the laser pointer and spare mic to the charging cradle so they will not roll into seat gaps.

scenes.setting: Front-hall star-map gallery greets apprentice (introduce three seat-number glow tags)
actions: In the morning front-hall star-map gallery, Gu Heng greets young Axing arriving with the commentary lift platform.

actions.action: Axing pushes the commentary lift platform to the gallery edge and locks the casters.
Gu Heng points to three seat-number glow tags and teaches Axing to mark interactive seats and question order with them.
Axing crouches in the front-hall star-map gallery, looking up at constellation reliefs mirrored in the floor tiles.
Gu Heng explains the rules: after the opening bell dim lights, point Big Dipper before turning the Milky Way, stop the platform before guests stand.
Axing glances back at the intact commentary lift platform, eyes full of longing.
Gu Heng has Axing grip the rail and practice an emergency stop before rising to mid-dome.
Axing tightens the turmeric armband and silently recites Gu Heng's three opening lines beside the script.

scenes.setting: Equipment mezzanine (only Achen)
actions: In the equipment mezzanine, Achen with an amber star brooch turns to look from the dark.
Achen walks slowly through the equipment mezzanine, flamboyant.
Achen brushes past a passerby; the amber star brooch sways lightly.
Achen stops at the passage mouth, pickily noting crooked cable labels in the mezzanine.
Achen kicks a spent zip tie beside the cable tray.
Achen leaves through the mezzanine between cable shadows.

scenes.setting: Front-hall star-map gallery: Axing and Achen co-presence
actions: In the front-hall star-map gallery, Axing and Achen stand side by side—one turmeric armband, one amber star brooch.
Axing hands Achen a found laser-pointer battery cover; they meet eyes with different looks.
Achen smooths Axing's turmeric armband, then deliberately clicks his own amber star brooch.
Axing and Achen walk slowly along the gallery edge; shadows overlap then part.
Axing lowers his head to check opening cues; Achen looks around.
Axing and Achen part at the gallery mouth, each going the opposite way.

scenes.setting: Dome planetarium (star-script book coffee-stained)
actions: Months later at night, Gu Heng keeps watch alone in the dome planetarium; the celestial globe's star lamp beads glow faintly.

actions.action: Gu Heng opens the star-script book and finds it already coffee-stained; show cues bled by coffee.

actions: Gu Heng wipes fingerprints from the celestial globe's brass meridian rings.
From a window Gu Heng looks at night beyond the front-hall star-map gallery.

actions.action: Light slowly moves across the celestial globe.

actions: Gu Heng slips blotting paper into the stained star-script book, sighs, and turns out the light.

scenes.setting: Planetarium commentary steady decade A (filler)
actions: Gu Heng wipes the celestial globe rim in the dome planetarium.
Gu Heng updates the day's notes on the wall.
Gu Heng restacks tools by number.
Gu Heng checks yesterday's records against the star-script book.
In the afternoon Gu Heng takes an outside call, brow faintly furrowed.
Gu Heng writes deferred items on a sticky note and posts it in plain view.
Gu Heng pulls spare materials out and sorts them alone.
At dusk Gu Heng turns off extra lights, leaving only the center lamp on the celestial globe.

scenes.setting: Planetarium commentary steady decade B (filler)
actions: Gu Heng spreads tracing paper or a comparison chart in the dome planetarium.
Gu Heng marks spots that need reinforcement with color dots.
Gu Heng fixes the paper edges against curling.
Against the already stained star-script book, Gu Heng struggles to read old figures.
Gu Heng sets drinks far away, fearing another splash on the star-script book.
On the wall Gu Heng lists three items to adjust.
A sound outside; Gu Heng looks up and listens a moment.
Gu Heng restrings labels with fine cord.

scenes.setting: Front-hall star-map gallery patrol day (filler · no count props)
actions: On patrol day, Gu Heng walks into the front-hall star-map gallery.
Gu Heng carefully tests whether floor or rails are steady.
Gu Heng notes spots that need repair.
Gu Heng shines a flashlight into dim corners.
Gu Heng briefly talks with a passing staffer.
Gu Heng avoids stacked clutter and rounds to the other side.
Gu Heng records size changes with a tape or by eye.
Gu Heng writes results on a cuff sticky note.

scenes.setting: Front-hall star-map gallery patrol (recall seat-number glow tags · kids swivel-chair false friend)
actions: At dawn, Gu Heng patrols the front-hall star-map gallery; the commentary lift platform waits in place.

actions.action: Gu Heng crouches to check the commentary lift platform's cables, emergency-stop button, and nonslip tread.
Gu Heng walks to the front commentary zone; those earlier three seat-number glow tags still glow as one-two-three.
A kids swivel chair is pushed through the star-map gallery—no lift cables or commentary rail, definitely not the commentary lift platform.
Standing in the front-hall star-map gallery, Gu Heng notes floor-tile glare and guest flow on the venue checklist.
Gu Heng locks the commentary lift platform casters and clips the safety chain.
Gu Heng confirms again that none of the three seat-number glow tags is missing; numbers still clear.
By the ticket desk Gu Heng writes the patrol date.

scenes.setting: Eve-of-disaster readiness (filler)
actions: On the eve of disaster, Gu Heng stores all materials by the window into cabinets.
Gu Heng covers the celestial globe with protective cloth.
Gu Heng checks that the star-script book is in a dry drawer.
Gu Heng tightens bottle caps and valves and moves them high.
A strange sound far off; dome planetarium lights flicker once.
Gu Heng neatens the cables of the five track spotlights.
Gu Heng drafts a notice reading Stop work tomorrow.
Gu Heng listens whether the two opening cue bells are chimed by wind.

scenes.setting: Fault night (celestial globe jammed · lift platform crash)
actions: A circuit fault hits; dome lights flash wildly; the celestial globe spins out of control.
A jolt flips script pages; a piercing metal cry comes from the gear housing.

actions.action: The celestial globe gears jam; star lamp beads half-lit; the meridian ring skews stuck.
At hall side, the commentary lift platform still hangs at mid-height.
Cables snap; the commentary lift platform crashes; rails twist into wreckage.
In the planetarium Gu Heng lunges at the console, jams the emergency stop, and shields the jammed celestial globe.
A flung mic gashes Gu Heng's temple; blood soaks gauze; he still stares at the gear housing.
The jammed celestial globe trembles faintly in the dim; star points flicker.

scenes.setting: Aftermath (lift-platform indirect reference · track-spotlight recall)

actions.action: The day after the disaster, Gu Heng stands in the dome planetarium staring at the already gear-jammed celestial globe.
Gu Heng brushes damage on the celestial globe with a finger, face dark.
On the equipment-fault whiteboard Gu Heng notes the date the commentary lift platform was destroyed.
An old photo of the commentary lift platform risen to mid-dome still nails the wall; Gu Heng gazes a long while.
Gu Heng twists on one of the five track spotlights and sits alone in the light spot.
The jammed celestial globe still sits at hall center; the skewed meridian ring is shocking.
Gu Heng changes the blood-soaked dressing and keeps picking up snapped cables and broken mic heads.
Gu Heng resets the dust cover, fearing more dust into the gear housing.

scenes.setting: Cleanup and funding request (filler)
actions: In cleanup week, Gu Heng packs snapped cables and smashed control buttons into a carton.
Gu Heng submits a funding request for gears, lamp beads, and calibration software.
Every day Gu Heng still comes to the dome planetarium and stares at the damaged celestial globe.
Gu Heng copies still-readable star-point coordinates in pencil.
Gu Heng turns the stained star-script book to a blank page and switches to logging funding progress.
Axing is on leave; only Gu Heng's footsteps fill the dome planetarium.
Out of habit Gu Heng looks toward the empty lift well at hall side.
On the wall Gu Heng lists a recalibration checklist.

scenes.setting: Recalibrated (third state · pocket desktop star-map false friend)
actions: Weeks later, Gu Heng hooks up the calibration computer, lays out gear lubricant and spare lamp beads, and begins recalibrating the celestial globe.

actions.action: Gu Heng takes out a pocket desktop star-map instrument—star points like the celestial globe but no brass meridian ring, and it cannot project the dome.

actions: Gu Heng clears jammed gears, replaces half-dead lamp beads, then enters precession calibration parameters.

actions.action: The last star-point set aligns; the celestial globe finishes recalibration; a shallow repair weld remains on the base.

actions: After recalibration the celestial globe rotates smooth; Big Dipper bearing matches the dome scale; Gu Heng looks on with relief.

actions.action: Gu Heng pushes the pocket desktop star-map instrument aside, leaving only the true celestial globe at the dome-center demo post.
The dome planetarium falls quiet again; the recalibrated celestial globe alone holds center.

scenes.setting: False friends: silver cleaning lift and venue shift leader Lao Liang

actions.action: Facilities pushes in a silver cleaning lift—wide flat platform, no commentary rail, nothing like the long-wrecked commentary lift platform.
Venue shift leader Lao Liang walks into the front-hall star-map gallery and talks beside Gu Heng; the two builds are alike.
Venue shift leader Lao Liang points at the silver cleaning lift, telling Gu Heng the cleaner only services shades and stays off the commentary path.
The silver cleaning lift leaves; Gu Heng alone watches it go from the front-hall star-map gallery.
The silver cleaning lift pauses briefly far off, then rolls on.
Before leaving, venue shift leader Lao Liang pats Gu Heng's shoulder; the key cap badge flashes once under the lamp.

scenes.setting: False friend: intern Xiaoyao who resembles Axing

actions.action: Into the front-hall star-map gallery comes intern Xiaoyao; at a glance he somewhat resembles young Axing.
Intern Xiaoyao practices gripping a mic for the opening; Gu Heng shakes his head—he is not Axing after all.
Intern Xiaoyao shyly asks from which side the Milky Way rises; Gu Heng answers briefly and sends him to dim the front-hall lightboxes.
Gu Heng alone stands in the front-hall star-map gallery, staring at the empty commentary lift platform berth.

scenes.setting: Steady decade after recalibration (filler)
actions: In the first decade after recalibration, Gu Heng checks the celestial globe every morning first.
Gu Heng writes new records on blank pages of the stained star-script book.
Gu Heng refuses to set dangerous items on edges again.
Gu Heng checks announcement copy with outside staff.
In the dome planetarium Gu Heng practices steadier operation.
Afternoon light falls on the recalibrated celestial globe.
Gu Heng polishes the opening cue bells but does not strike them yet.
Gu Heng receives Axing's postcard and presses it under a lamp base unopened.
In the dome planetarium Gu Heng test-runs a short commentary.
Gu Heng soft-cloth-wipes the celestial globe's brass meridian rings.
Gu Heng turns the star-script book to the interactive Q&A page.
Gu Heng checks whether the track spotlights slide smoothly.
In the front-hall star-map gallery Gu Heng adjusts seat-number glow tag positions.
Gu Heng test-taps an opening cue bell to confirm volume.
Gu Heng replaces laser-pointer batteries.
On the console Gu Heng saves tonight's show presets.
Gu Heng wipes front-row seat armrests clean.
Gu Heng checks that the Big Dipper badge is pinned straight.
In the equipment mezzanine Gu Heng patrols cable temperatures.
Gu Heng returns the spare mic to the charging cradle.
At the dome edge Gu Heng checks projection focus.
Gu Heng writes updated audience-notice sentences.
Gu Heng dims half the lights to simulate opening atmosphere.
In the break room Gu Heng drinks a sip of warm water to wet his throat.
Gu Heng confirms exit indicator lights stay on.

scenes.setting: Year-end close (filler)
actions: At year-end close, Gu Heng binds the year's materials month by month.
Gu Heng alone bags the stained star-script book into an archive sleeve.
Gu Heng prints before-and-after repair photos and clips them into the archive.
Gu Heng clears the bench, leaving only needed tools and one lamp.
Gu Heng oils key tools against rust.
Beside the celestial globe's repair mark Gu Heng signs a date.
Weather turns cold outside; dome planetarium heat or stove ticks softly.
Gu Heng finishes the annual summary; the cover bears only a short theme.

scenes.setting: Late years (Gu Heng wounded · opening-cue-bell long-range recall)

actions.action: Years later at dusk, still-scarred slow-stepping Gu Heng leans on a folding cane at the abandoned observatory plinth.

actions: Gu Heng looks up at the abandoned observatory plinth ruins, gaze far away.

actions.action: Beside the abandoned observatory plinth, those two opening cue bells are brought back and hung; they chime lightly in the wind.

actions: Gu Heng sets a palm on the cold copper-column base, as if saying goodbye.

actions.action: Gu Heng slowly sits to catch breath a moment.
The two opening cue bells chime again; Gu Heng closes his eyes to listen, as to the old curtain-up cue.

scenes.setting: Old-site lingering decade (filler)
actions: Every day Gu Heng still returns to the dome planetarium, but spends more time sitting watching the celestial globe.
Gu Heng leans the folding cane by the door; he moves slower than before.
Gu Heng lets a young assistant draft notes and only checks them himself.
Gu Heng photos the recalibrated celestial globe for distant Axing.
On the last page of the stained star-script book Gu Heng writes Handover without signing.
Gu Heng refuses hospital stay and insists on sitting at the abandoned observatory plinth each week.
Gu Heng wipes a draft of the copper memorial plaque.
At night the dome planetarium keeps only one lamp; Gu Heng dozes in the light circle.

scenes.setting: Axing returns · Gu Heng bows out

actions.action: By day, adult Axing returns along the abandoned observatory plinth and hurries toward the ruins.

actions: At the abandoned observatory plinth Axing reunites with slow-stepping Gu Heng; they embrace.

actions.action: Beside a cot in the dome planetarium, Axing holds Gu Heng's thin hand.
Gu Heng's breath fades; he finally closes his eyes and quietly passes away.
Axing stands long at the abandoned observatory plinth; tears fall to the ground.
Axing pins Gu Heng's Big Dipper badge to his own collar.

scenes.setting: Relics · copper memorial plaque (indirect reference to the deceased)

actions.action: Behind the dome planetarium door Gu Heng's old coat still hangs; Axing reaches to stroke it gently.
Beside the abandoned observatory plinth, adult Axing stands before a newly nailed copper memorial plaque.
Axing's fingertip traces Gu Heng's name carved on the copper memorial plaque.
Axing sets a white chrysanthemum under the lower edge of the copper memorial plaque.
Wind crosses the abandoned observatory plinth; Axing softly reads the year on the plaque.

scenes.setting: Axing and Achen reunite (adult misidentification + co-presence)

actions.action: Remade-face adult Achen arrives and tightly embraces Axing at the abandoned observatory plinth.

actions: Axing and Achen stand side by side by the copper memorial plaque—one quiet-eyed, one deep-faced.
Achen touches his amber star brooch, then looks at the Big Dipper badge on Axing's collar.
They look at each other in silence, at faces alike and yet unlike.
Axing and Achen walk together toward the end; shadows merge into one.

actions.action: The shot returns to years ago—that youth in a turmeric armband first holding a script in the star-map gallery appears again.

actions.action: Again that row of five old milky-shade fixtures on the dome track.

actions.action: Back to that front-hall corridor with constellation reliefs of first meeting; reflective floor tiles are as they were.

scenes.setting: Close (stained star-script long-range · seat-number glow-tag long-range)

actions.action: Axing reopens that already coffee-stained star-script book and walks into the dome planetarium.
In the front commentary zone, those earlier three seat-number glow tags still glow neat.
Axing takes over watch of the celestial globe; the repair mark is clear under the lights.
Axing twists on the five track spotlights; light fills the space again.
Axing stands straight before the recalibrated celestial globe, checking opening cues and star-point coordinates as Gu Heng once did.
